newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel confident will meet 1997 aims.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel confident will meet 1997 aims.

text.p: Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel executive chairman Patrick Ponsolle said on Thursday he was confident the company would be able to hit its most favourable projections for 1997.

Speaking at an extraordinary general meeting held for a vote on a debt restructuring plan, Ponsolle said he was "extremely confident" about the capacity of the group "to reach the targets of the best-case scenario for 1997."
Eurotunnel said in the prospectus for its April debt plan, being voted today, that it hoped to show a net profit in 2005 and pay a dividend the next year.
